simple.meaning: גָּעַשׁ (gâʻash) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to agitate violently.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 10 times in 2 Samuel, Job, Psalms, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Samuel 22:8. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּעַשׁ (H1607) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גָּעַשׁ (gâʻash) / H1607 is traced through 2 Samuel 22:8, Job 34:20, Psalms 18:8, Jeremiah 5:22 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1607. gaash [ גָּעַשׁ ] verb shake, quake (Late Hebrew id. ) — Qal Imperfect וַתִּגְעַשׁ Psa 18:8 a = 2Sam 22:8 a Kt (Qr Hithpa`el); — quake of earth at theoph., Psa 18:8 = 2Sam 22:8 (read Kt; || רעשׁ ). Pu`al Imperfect be shaken up, convulsed יְגֹעֲשׁוּעַֿם Job 34:20 a people are convulsed . Hithpa`el shake back and forth, toss or reel to and fro וַיִּתְגָּעַשׁ Qr 2Sam 22:8 a (< Kt Qal ); יִתְגָָּֽעֲשׁוּ Jer 46:7 , וַיִּתְגָָּֽעֲשׁוּ Psa 18:8 b + 2t.; — of mountains 18:8 b = 2Sam 22:8 b; of waves of sea, Jer 5:22 ; of waters of Nile 46:7 (compare 46:8 ). Hithpo`el Perfect וְהִתְגֹּעֲשׁוּ consecutive Jer 25:16 ; Imperfect יִתְגֹּעֲשׁוּ 46:8 ; id. of waters of Nile 46:8 ; of drunken men, reel to and fro , 25:16 (figurative of nations confounded by ׳י ).
